link_fallback: If the button doesn't work, open this link:
test_description: Your email setup is working correctly!
email_verification_preview: Confirm the email address for your {appName} account
email_verification_description: Hello {name}, confirm that this is the email address for your {appName} account. The link expires in 24 hours.
one_time_access_description: Enter this code to sign in to {appName}. It expires in {expiration}.
one_time_access_manual: Or open {#link}{loginLink}{/link} and enter the code manually. If you didn't ask for this code, you can ignore this email.
signup_invitation_preview: You're invited to create an account on {appName}
signup_invitation_description: Create your account on {appName} with the link below. It expires in {expiration}.
signup_invitation_ignore: If you weren't expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.
new_sign_in_preview: A new sign-in to your {appName} account was detected
new_sign_in_description: Your {appName} account was accessed from a new IP address or browser. If this was you, there's nothing to do.
new_sign_in_review: Don't recognize this? Review the passkeys in your {#link}account settings{/link} and remove any you don't know.
api_key_expiring_description: Hello {name}, one of your API keys expires soon. Anything that uses it will stop working once it expires.
